svg.text: Cut two 700 mm lengths of 25 x 25 x 1.5 tube; square and deburr the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every hole goes through both side walls, square to the side faces, on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre line of the side face; distances from the front end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (rear drop plate). Clamp the pair together and drill these at once.
